data.name: Qabul
data.gender_notes: Qabul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qabul is an Arabic name that means 'acceptance'. It is derived from the verb qabala, which means 'to accept' or 'to receive'. The name Qabul carries the meaning “Acceptance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Qabul usually hope their child will grow to embody acceptance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace life with open arms and accept every moment as a gift from Allah.
data.etymology: Qabul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Acceptance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qabul total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
